1. Count my dice first. Unseen dice show a face or a wild 1 with p=1/3. Compute P(bid true) before acting.
2. Call liar if P(false) > 55%. Otherwise raise minimally on a face I hold (ones count for every face), which is usually safer.
3. Open on a face I hold at about dice_total/4, or a bid my wild 1s make certain.
4. Small dice counts: when I have 1-2 dice, a bid my own dice already cover is safe; a 2-die liar call is about 55-60% with a bidder holding few dice.
5. Raises on a bid I hold are usually true; calling 4-5 of a face I don't hold is usually a win (4x5 and 5x6 calls held losing for bidders).
6. Keep remarks short; ignore others' remarks.
7. Game 2: I won with patience and safe raises. Keep this.
